memory_update.text: AMKR should remain the US-listed OSAT reference anchor for HBM/advanced-packaging overflow, but it is not the cleanest underfollowed alpha candidate because market cap and AI packaging awareness are already higher.
FORM is a high-quality HBM test-interface candidate: explicit HBM probe-card evidence, but now above the preferred sub-USD-10B range, so monitor valuation/attention creep in later layers.

KLIC is an underfollowed advanced-packaging equipment hypothesis: the key follow-up is proving that thermocompression/HBM-related systems are becoming material rather than just optionality around a legacy assembly-equipment base.
Layer 2 should separate direct HBM stack exposure from indirect advanced packaging, CPO, chiplet, and conventional-memory overflow exposure; otherwise the node map will overstate purity.
